name: io.github.jokeks2023/huly-mcp-selfhost
description: MCP server for Huly (self-hosted + cloud): 224 tools for AI agents, few tokens, Claude Code plugin

environmentVariables.name: HULY_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Huly account email (option A, together with HULY_PASSWORD)

environmentVariables.name: HULY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Huly token for SSO accounts without a password (option B, get it via `npx huly-mcp-setup`)

environmentVariables.name: HULY_ACCOUNTS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Account service URL for self-hosted Huly. Default: https://account.huly.app

environmentVariables.name: HULY_FRONT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Front URL of your Huly instance, enables document/description content and uploads

environmentVariables.name: HULY_TRANSACTOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional, self-hosted: internal transactor address (e.g. ws://huly/_transactor) instead of the public one

environmentVariables.name: HULY_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: pin the server to one workspace (slug, name or id); tools then need no workspace argument

environmentVariables.name: HULY_ANNOTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Optional: 1 = tool annotations (title, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint); ~16% larger tool list

environmentVariables.name: HULY_DYNAMIC_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional: 1 = start with HULY_TOOLSETS and load more toolsets on demand via enable_toolsets

environmentVariables.name: HULY_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional: comma-separated toolsets (agent, tracker, tracker-admin, documents, chat, contacts, inbox, activity, planner, calendar, github, generic, generic-write, collaboration, cards, fields, drive, templates, testing, products, members, recruiting, crm, hr, inventory, meetings, qms, process, surveys) or 'all'

environmentVariables.name: HULY_WRITE_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional: only allow changes in these projects, e.g. TSK,WEB

environmentVariables.name: HULY_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: Optional: auto (default), strict or off — ask before deletes and other risky tools

environmentVariables.name: HULY_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional: file to append every change to (JSON lines)

environmentVariables.name: HULY_FILE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: directory for local file upload/download (off when unset)
